statements.statement: Patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
Patient has known unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
Patient has personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73)
The service was denied under reason code CO-97
The denial reason is that the service is bundled into another covered procedure
Prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring was indicated to evaluate arrhythmia burden and guide anticoagulation management
This monitoring service addressed a distinct clinical question
The service should be separately reimbursed rather than bundled
